text:
Alex Chen: Proposal: RBAC refactor for Console. Make billing/org perms explicit instead of Editor implicitly having them. Planning migration script and UI gating. Need feedback before rollout.
Jamie Patel: Quick Q — user-visible impact? will editors suddenly lose access?
Alex Chen: Editors will no longer get billing/org admin by default. We add flags: BillingAccess and OrgAdmin. Viewer remains read-only. Admin unchanged.
Sophia Reyes: Migration plan idea: if Editor showed billing activity in last 90d, keep BillingAccess; otherwise revoke automatically and flag for manual review. All changes must emit audit events.
Alex Chen: Proposed mapping (code):
```
old_role -> new_roles
Viewer -> Viewer
Editor -> Editor + BillingAccess (if billing_activity_90d)
Admin -> Admin + BillingAccess + OrgAdmin
```
Morgan Li: Frontend note: please hide UI affordances (buttons/links). We had a regression where Delete Key button stayed visible and just returned 403 — confusing UX. Need central hook usePerms(['billing:write']).
Dennis O'Neil: Agreed. Backend must stay strict (403s) but frontend should gate. Also we should centralize permission helpers to avoid bitrot.
sec-bot: Audit event created: RBAC_PROPOSAL_CREATED by Alex Chen; id=rbac-20250315-01
Sophia Reyes: Audit/KMS: migration script must emit events with who (system/user), old_role, new_role, reason. Events should be wrapped/signed with KMS-backed envelope for tamper evidence. Retain migration report (S3) encrypted with KMS.
Jamie Patel: KMS question: hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS; private deployments should support customer-managed key (CMK) ARNs. Is that the plan?
Alex Chen: Yes. Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS for audit envelopes. Private: allow injecting customer key ARN at migration. Migration accepts key binding param.
Morgan Li: Vulnerability triage: we must prevent any Viewer->Editor elevation during migration window. Suggest migration lock: make role-assignment endpoints read-only during migration and run a short canary.
Dennis O'Neil: Rollout proposal:
- Build migration tool in infra account
- Dry-run on staging orgs
- Canary on 5 opt-in small prod orgs with tight monitoring
- Full run in low-traffic window
- Provide rollback script to reapply snapshots
Sophia Reyes: Monitoring/alerts: track audit log spikes, KMS sign failures, permission-denied error rate, and customer 403 feedback. Alert p1 for unexpected role-assignment activity or KMS sign errors.
Alex Chen: Devops: introduce feature flag redwood.rbac.v2 for phased rollout. Produce migration report artifact (S3) listing changed orgs and counts; encrypt it with KMS.
Jamie Patel: UX copy: where BillingAccess is revoked show tooltip "Billing access revoked. Contact your org admin to request access." plus link to request flow.
Morgan Li: Tests: unit tests for gating helper, e2e for UI hidden elements, integration tests verifying audit events and KMS envelopes. Also add a test that frontend doesn't rely on string role name comparisons (use bitmask).
sec-bot: Vulnerability triage noted: GH#4921 flagged frontend role-string comparison. PR#4980 changes to stable permission bitmask. Marked security-sensitive.
Dennis O'Neil: Owners: Alex (migration + backend), Sophia (audit + kms), Morgan (frontend + tests), Jamie (product messaging + UX). I'll create infra/tasks and perms tickets.
Alex Chen: I'll open the migration PR and schedule a staging dry-run tomorrow morning. Please review the permission matrix doc at /docs/console/rbac.md.
Jamie Patel: Will review tonight. :thumbsup:
Sophia Reyes: Compliance checklist: 1) audit events emitted, 2) KMS signing verified, 3) retention policy applied, 4) migration report stored encrypted, 5) manual review window for flagged orgs.
Morgan Li: Reminder to update docs and add deprecation note for Editor implicit billing.
Dennis O'Neil: Also add an incidents playbook entry for RBAC migration failures in incidents/ so oncall knows rollback steps.
Alex Chen: If no objections I'll merge dry-run patch today and kick off staging run. Thanks everyone.
